name: Aerodrums 2
summary:
This is the companion app for the Aerodrums 2 air drumming instrument (sold separately). Seamlessly connect to your Aerodrums 2 device over WiFi and see your drum kit materialize before your eyes. Choose your kit, jam to your favorite tunes, practice with a metronome, or record your performances. No Aerodrums 2? No problem! The app will let you play a basic drum kit in mixed reality using hand-tracking.
